tasks.title: Design PostgreSQL schema (users, profiles, courses, notes, ratings, groups, memberships, join requests, messages, notifications, reports) with migrations and indexes

Set up Express/Node project, React app shell, design tokens (indigo theme, Inter), responsive layout with bottom nav/sidebar, shared UI components (buttons, inputs, cards, sheets, toasts), and HTTPS deployment
Build Sign Up, Log In and Profile screens in the designer's style: Sign Up, verification banner, and Profile editor (major, courses chips)
Implement registration with university email domain check, bcrypt hashing, JWT auth, email verification and resend, plus profile edit API and UI
Design Notes Library, Note Preview and Upload Note screens (cards, filters, sort toggle, upload states)
Implement note upload to AWS S3 (PDF/image, 20 MB limit, presigned upload) with virus scan before publish and note publish API
Implement note browse, Postgres full-text search, course/topic filters, sort by relevance/rating, ratings, bookmarks, and Notes Library UI
Design Study Groups screens (My Groups/Discover tabs, create sheet, join requests, manage members)
Implement study groups: create group (creator becomes admin), public/private join, join request approve/reject, member removal, discovery search, and UI
Design Group Feed screen (chat bubbles, attached note bubble, composer, notification panel)
Implement group feed with WebSocket real-time messages (under 5s), note attachments, likes, and in-app notifications with per-group toggle and unread badge
Implement reporting (report sheet on notes and posts, queue API), moderator role queue UI, remove/dismiss content, hide content and notify uploader
Implement privacy and account settings: data deletion request flow (30-day SLA), terms/privacy links, and role-based access checks for Student, Group Admin, Moderator, System Admin
Run QA and hardening: acceptance-criteria tests per feature, accessibility pass (WCAG AA), 3-click flow check, load test for 500 concurrent users, and production deploy with monitoring

risks: Virus scanning of uploads (e.g., ClamAV or S3-triggered Lambda) may add integration time and delay note publishing; mitigate by publishing as pending until scan passes.
Real-time WebSocket messaging and notifications are the most complex pieces; fall back to short-interval polling if delivery under 5 seconds is at risk.
University email verification depends on a domain allowlist and reliable email delivery (SES/SendGrid); deliverability or domain gaps could block sign-ups.
Meeting the 500-concurrent-user performance target and 99.5% uptime on a small team may need extra tuning of search indexes and infrastructure beyond the MVP timeline.
Copyright and GDPR obligations (takedown handling, data deletion within 30 days) may require legal review and process work that could extend the schedule.
